decisions.reason: The rotating-skip compact dumper builds directly on the firm's core construction vehicle know-how, so the firm can absorb market feedback and refine it with its own R&D.
The articulated dumper extends the firm's established vehicle engineering and service base, which gives it strong capacity to learn from results and adapt the product to customers.

The mine rescue vehicle is distant from the core offer, but the firm's underground vehicle experience and its own R&D, together with the long sales cycles of this niche, justify keeping it a while longer.
The material lift is close to the established offer and has documented rental popularity and a recent large order, so the firm can readily interpret and build on its success.

Although the mining loader is distant from the core offer, the quantified field result of 1,000 operating hours in 7 months gives concrete learning that the firm's underground engineering experience and R&D can turn into improvements.
